Strategy name: BTC RSI mean reversion
Market: BTC/USDT
Timeframe: 1h

Entry:
Buy only when close is above SMA 200 and RSI 14 is below 32.

Exit:
Close when RSI 14 is above 58 or close falls below SMA 200.

Risk:
Start with 1000 USDT.
Use 20 percent of equity per trade.
Stop loss 3 percent.
Take profit 7 percent.
Fees 8 bps.
Slippage 5 bps.
Reject if max drawdown is above 18 percent.
